title: Session memory.index.yaml
description: L1 session index: node paths and retrieval metadata only (no bodies). Generated by brain-rebuild-session-index.sh per read_policy exclusions in memory-demotion.yml.

contract_version.description: Index contract version; bump when node entry shape changes.

task_id.description: Session task id (e.g. cursor session id) owning this index.

project_slug.description: kb-identity slug used when building this index.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the index was last rebuilt.

nodes.description: Retrievable KB node refs for this session; excludes demoted, quarantined, and invalidated paths per read_policy.

path.description: Vault-relative path to the node file (no body content in index).

lifecycle_state.description: Canonical retrieval state from node frontmatter.

retrieval_weight.description: Effective weight for L1 ranking; 0 for excluded states.

title.description: Optional frontmatter title for L1 display without L2 read.
